title: Nobody's In Charge Here
hook: No stop, no yield, no paint. Somebody still has to go second.
scene: Two gravel roads cross at the section line. No sign in any direction, no signal, nothing painted. A dusty pickup is coming from your right at about the same speed you are, and it is arriving at about the same time.

source.psdp_skill: Skill twelve: driving on rural roads
source.teaching_target: NEW: PSDP twelve Uncontrolled intersections + DOL 4.15 Uncontrolled Intersection child.

image_brief.subject: two gravel roads crossing with no stop, no yield, no paint; a dusty pickup arriving from the right at the same time; full-grid cage; carrier (hard-sided, wire grille door facing inboard, Gracie's orange tabby markings visible behind the grille, belt routed through the handle)
image_brief.foreground: worn black wheel, faded pink dash DARK/UNLIT, FULL-GRID welded steel mesh over the entire windshield (VI-009 cage canon) — not a low dash-level band; missing windshield cage is a hard FAIL; carrier (hard-sided, wire grille door facing inboard, Gracie's orange tabby markings visible behind the grille, belt routed through the handle)
image_brief.midground: empty uncontrolled gravel intersection; dusty pickup entering from the right
image_brief.background: Backcountry east of Ribbon — Pacific Northwest only (fir, moss, wet gray); one continuous stretch; no arid canyon, no high desert, no NYC/Spokane drift; section-line country, fir edges
image_brief.read: no stop or yield; a pickup arrives from the right at the same time

no belt not routed through handle
no carrier door facing outboard toward camera

geometry.ego_lane_side: approaching an unmarked gravel crossroads in the right half
geometry.ego_nose_in_frame: plow points up-frame into the empty cross

variation.forced: Act VI Claude overflow locks: PNW Backcountry east of Ribbon; full-grid cage; carrier SPEC verbatim; no Mya; dark dash; no seed

decision: No signs, and you'll both arrive together. Who goes?

options.text: He's on your right — slow, look twice, let him through
options.result: You come off it, check both ways twice, and let him have it. He lifts a finger off the wheel.

options.text: You were there first — keep your speed
options.result: Uncontrolled means nobody has it by default. You arrived together and you both believed you were first.

options.text: Speed up and clear it before he gets there
options.result: You race a stranger through a blind crossing on the theory that whoever commits harder wins.

options.text: Stop dead in the middle and wave him on
options.result: You stop in the intersection, in dust, on gravel, and now nobody knows what either of you is doing.

debrief: At an uncontrolled intersection, slow down, check both ways twice, and yield to the vehicle on your right.
